text:
naomi_csm: Kicking off AtlasCare onboarding. They're running Redwood Private in their GCP project for PHI workloads. Target: ~6 weeks. Owners I suggest: Naomi (CSM), Tom (SE), Pri (Ops), Elaine (Enablement), Mike (Program). Add if missing.

naomi_csm: Draft success criteria:
- Private VPC peering & private endpoints validated
- SAML + SCIM provisioning tested end-to-end
- PHI field mapping signed off by AtlasCare (POE)
- Demo flows p50 latency <300ms for 95% of requests
- Runbook + 2 training sessions delivered + recording

tom_se: Ill own integration checklist and test harness. Need sample payloads and SAML metadata from Pri's contact. I'll post checklist by EOW. :+1:

pri_ops: I'll handle GCP networking, firewall rules, and service account/KMS access. Quick Q: expected pilot RPS? that determines pooling and batch sizes.

mike_pm: AtlasCare expects low pilot traffic (~30 RPS), steady state ~120 RPS. I'll confirm with their PM.

elaine_enable: Enablement will do one dev session + one ops runbook review (90m each), produce quickstart + recording.

naomi_csm: Primary risks: delayed SAML metadata, ambiguous PHI schema mapping, KMS/service-account permission delays, and any legal addenda (HIPAA/BAA).

naomi_csm: Proposed timeline:
W0: kickoff + collect SAML/SCIM samples
W1: infra & networking (GCP peering, firewall, KMS)
W2-3: integration & test payload validation
W4: pilot (canary)
W5: iterate & runbook prep
W6: go-live + 30d health check

naomi_csm: Actions:
- Naomi: request SAML/SCIM metadata + sample payloads from AtlasCare (by Tue)
- Tom: integration checklist draft (EOW)
- Pri: infra checklist & service account steps (mid next week)
- Elaine: training slots + slide draft (next Thu)
- Mike: confirm RPS and legal contact (today)

naomi_csm: @onboardbot schedule a 45m kickoff with AtlasCare next Wed 10:30am PT and paste link here.

onboardbot: Meeting scheduled: Wed 10:30 AM PT — 45m — "AtlasCare: Redwood Private Onboarding Kickoff" Join: https://meet.example.com/atlascare-kickoff (invites sent).

tom_se: I'll block time.

pri_ops: Will start the infra checklist and flag permission items for legal/KMS.

elaine_enable: I'll draft agenda and share slides 24h before the meeting.

naomi_csm: Thanks team. I'll update thread as we get artifacts from AtlasCare. If anything threatens the timeline, call it out here or DM me. :shipit:
